entities.summary: Khrystyna Antoniichuk or Antoniychuk is a former professional tennis player from Ukraine. Her highest WTA singles ranking is 163, which she reached on 8 March 2010. Her career-high in doubles is 275, which she achieved on 12 April 2010. Kristina Antoniychuk was a athletes & competitors from Kolomyia (b. 1990-09-04, Kolomyia).
